items.title: Ethereum Gets Another Privacy Boost as Aztec Brings Back zk.money
items.summary: Aztec Labs relaunched its self-custodial zk.money wallet on Aztec Network, letting users make private stablecoin payments using readable tags.

items.title: BlackRock Sees Stablecoins Powering AI Agent Payments
items.summary: The asset manager points to tiny, round-the-clock payments for data and computing power, while traditional checkout systems retain a role.

items.title: Crypto regulation at SEC, CFTC to come down to 3 commissioners following key resignation
items.summary: Seven commissioner seats at the SEC and CFTC will be empty after Friday, leaving only a few leaders at financial regulators to oversee aspects of the $3 trillion crypto industry.

items.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin correction could be near as traders’ unrealized profit hits 21-month high
items.summary: Bitcoin could face a near-term correction as short-term traders' onchain unrealized profit margin has reached its highest level in 21 months, according to CryptoQuant.
